title: Flashing.
officialText:
Exposed edges of thin exterior structural glass veneer shall be flashed with overlapping corrosion-resistant
metal flashing or equivalent and caulked with a waterproof compound in a manner to effectively prevent the entrance of moisture
between the glass veneer and the backing.
